verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents Llama as downloadable open weights with a CLI, local runtimes, and third-party hosting partners. Nothing in it documents requests- or tokens-per-unit-time limits, tier scaling, or 429 behavior. Partner hosting such as AWS, Azure, and Groq is a host-platform capability and earns no credit, and the docs surface was found gated behind SSO with no OpenAPI spec published.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read documented rate limits — requests and tokens per unit time, how tiers scale, and what a 429 looks like — before I hit them in production
